thread:
maria: Kicking off canary for service-gateway v3.2.1 to prod-us-east now. Change window 16:00-18:00 UTC. Link to quick backout runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-backout (follow the checklist at top).

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: service-gateway v3.2.1 -> prod-us-east (10% traffic). Monitor group: @samir, @aj. Canary ID: cb-1777.
samir: Watching latency and 5xx dashboards. Will call out if error rate > 0.5% sustained for 3m.
aj: If we see sign of regression, prefer canary abort and pin to v3.2.0 commit sha: 9a1b2c. We should only full rollback if abort fails or stateful migrations are implicated.
maria: Agreed. Ops play: abort canary -> pin traffic to previous -> run post-checks -> promote hotfix branch if needed.
ops-rookie: Quick question — who runs the pin? I can do the pin if someone runs the traffic rollback command.
olivia: SRE will run the pin. Command sequence is in the runbook, but shorthand: `deploy-bot abort --canary cb-1777` then `traffic-control pin --service service-gateway --version 3.2.0 --reason "canary abort 1777777777"`.
maria: Also note the quick health checks we use: `/scripts/check-http-health.sh prod-us-east service-gateway` and `kubectl get pods -l app=service-gateway -n prod -o wide`.
deploy-bot: Canary health probe summary (t+2m): latency +8% vs baseline, 5xx 0.12%. No automatic abort threshold hit.
samir: markers: CPU normal, memory up slightly. 5xx trending up but still below 0.5%. Will update in 3m.
aj: If 5xx crosses 0.3% and keeps rising for 3 intervals, flag as abort candidate. We don't want to wait too long and take customer impact.
maria: Agreed. If we abort, call the oncall channel and set incident tag so release notes capture it.
ops-rookie: Copy. If abort happens I will run through the post-abort checklist and paste the outputs here.
(deploy-bot automated): Canary aborted by aj at 1777777805. Canary ID cb-1777 -> aborted.
maria: Thanks — initiating pin to v3.2.0 now. Olivia, can you confirm pin completed and cluster routes updated?
olivia: Pin command executed: `traffic-control pin --service service-gateway --version 3.2.0 --by olivia --ticket #INC-4521`. Routes switched. Verifying health checks...
deploy-bot: Traffic shift complete: 100% -> v3.2.0 in prod-us-east. Rollback tag: rb-1777777805.
samir: Health checks green on all endpoints. 5xx back to baseline. Latency normalized.
aj: Great. Maria, please file a short postmortem entry and add whether we need a rollback-hotfix branch or revert commit. Leave decision open until QA review.
maria: Will open PR to revert the change and tag it for hotfix if QA fails. I'll paste PR link here when created.
ops-rookie: Post-abort checklist done, logs collected to s3://redwood-deploy-logs/1777777777-cb-1777.zip.
maria: Nice. Thanks everyone. Closing thread for now; will follow up with PR and release notes. :thumbsup:
(deploy-bot automated): Thread closed by maria at 1777777888.
